Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:

• Technically grounded
• Possess strong leadership and people management skills
• Structured and organized
A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
• Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
• Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
• Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
• Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
• Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.
Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:

• Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
• Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
• Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
• Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
• Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
• Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
• Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
• Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language
The perks of being at DESMI

• Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
• Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
• Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
• Pension – attractive employer contributions
• Private healthcare and life insurance
• On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
• Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties
What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
• A company that values sustainability and innovation.
We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Job Opening – 2 Full-Time Cooks

Company: Burgerklubben
CVR: 41375531
Location: Denmark
Number of positions: 2
Employment: Permanent, full-time
Start date: As soon as possible

Burgerklubben is looking for 2 skilled and reliable cooks to join our kitchen team.

Responsibilities

• 
Preparing and cooking meals

• 
Preparing ingredients and maintaining stock

• 
Ensuring consistent food quality and presentation

• 
Maintaining a clean and organized kitchen

• 
Following food safety and hygiene regulations

• 
Cooperating with the rest of the kitchen team

• 
Assisting with other kitchen duties when required

Requirements

• 
Relevant experience working as a cook

• 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• 
Reliable, responsible and punctual

• 
Able to work efficiently in a busy kitchen

• 
Flexible regarding working hours

• 
Knowledge of food safety and kitchen hygiene

• 
Ability to communicate in English or Danish

We offer

• 
Stable, full-time employment

• 
A professional and friendly working environment

• 
Salary based on qualifications and experience

• 
Good opportunities for professional development

• 
Varied duties and responsibility in the kitchen

Please send your CV and application to job@vejentil.dk with the subject line:

“Burgerklubben – Cook”

Applications are reviewed continuously – apply as soon as possible.

Er du en dygtig og erfaren asiatisk kok til fortrinvis kinesisk mad, så er det dig vi har brug for.
Restauranten er dedikeret til at tilbyde vores gæster en unik og autentisk asiatisk madoplevelse. 

Dine daglige opgaver er bl.a.:

• Bestilling og modtagelse af varer

• Opfølgning og tilsyn med takeaway ordrer og gæsternes med i restauranten

• Udvikle dele af køkkenmenuen i samarbejde med køkkenchefen

Du er glad, og smilendei din tilgang til andre mennesker, gæster såvel som kollegaer, også når der er travlt.

Når du starter, får du grundig oplæring og vi sørger for, at du løbende får ledelsestræning, så du bliver endnu bedre til at drive og udvikle køkkenet.

Dine arbejdstimer ligger indenfor 12-22 og bliver fordelt via vagtplan.

Dette er et krav at du behersker engelsk: I køkkenet arbejder flere forskellige nationaliteter og restaurantpersonalet er fortrinvis danskere.

Har du ikke hørt fra is indenfor 14 dage, er det fordi jobbet er blevet besat.

 

Cook for Asian food

If you are a skilled and experienced Asian chef with excellent Chinese food, then we need you.

The restaurant is dedicated to offering our guests a unique and authentic Asian dining experience.

Your daily tasks include:

• Ordering and receiving goods

• Follow-up and supervision of takeaway orders and guest's food in the restaurant

• Develop parts of the kitchen menu in collaboration with the chef

You are happy and smiling in your approach to other people, guests as well as colleagues,
even when it is hectic.

When you start, you will receive thorough training and we will ensure you continuously receive management training, so you become even better at running and developing the kitchen.

Your working hours are between 12-22 and are distributed via shift schedule.

Mastering English is a requirement: Several different nationalities work in the kitchen,  and the restaurant staff are mainly Danes. 

If you haven't heard from us within 14 days, it's because the job has been filled.

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Do you want to contribute to a secure, reliable construction and operation of renewbale assets for a international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry? PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of renewable energy assets. We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.
